title: A module's services (spec §5.11): the only compose a module contributes. scripts/compiler/services.ts enforces it; any other field is a compile error.

data.description: the module's data dir, data/modules/<module>/, for its services' `data` entries

build.description: a folder in the module with a Dockerfile; local marketplace sources only

env.description: ${settings.x}, ${secrets.y} (its file path), the module's legacy host variables

tmp.description: a tmpfs at /tmp of this size

data.description: <folder of the module's data dir>:<container path>[:ro]

state.description: the module's own vault dir (secrets.state: true) at this path

points.description: its own points' contributions (config/points/<module>.json) at this path, read-only

github_app.description: privileged: [git-credential] only: the GitHub App's vault dir (github-app/) at this path, read-only

workspaces.description: privileged: [git-credential] only: the job workspaces (the host's work_dir/tasks) at this path, read-write

egress.description: outbound Internet, on the module's own egress network

links.description: root services or networks the module's closed legacy list allows

on_demand.description: started only by `docker compose run` (profile <module>, no restart)

when.description: runs only while each named setting has this value

share.description: people reach it through the gate at https://<host> as app <module> (host from an instance setting; empty: not shared); needs ui_port; mounts the gate's public keys at /run/secrets/AIDENHQ_IDENTITY_KEYS
